verdict.rationale: Fireworks provides explicit first-party docs for uploading custom model weights (from Hugging Face, local files, S3, Azure Blob) and deploying LoRA adapters via live merge or multi-LoRA with dynamic loading, plus a CLI command (firectl) to deploy. This directly matches the ml-engineer story of uploading and serving custom weights/adapters. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the upload-and-serve workflow beyond vendor docs, and no evidence addressing edge cases like large custom architectures or cost transparency for this specific workflow (unrelated cost complaint about fine-tuning pricing exists but doesn't concretely contradict the upload/serve capability itself).
